skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and methods of land using investment project assessment, including financial, economic, and environmental feasibility.
Understand legal requirements and regulations related to land use and investment projects.
Analyze financial feasibility of land using investment projects.
Analyze economic and social feasibility of land using investment projects.
Assess environmental impact of land using investment projects.
Evaluate the suitability of project locations based on legal, economic, and environmental factors.
Work effectively in groups to analyze and present project assessment findings.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate project risks and make investment decisions.
Conduct research and analyze data to support project assessment.
Effectively present project assessment findings and defend conclusions.
